How it works

Simple + hard training till absolute failure.

The program uses a repeating Push A → Pull → Legs → Push B rotation. Instead of stuffing sessions with junk volume, the plan keeps the focus on strong technique, hard sets, and beating your previous performance.

01

Hit the rep range

Choose honest loads that put your working sets inside the 8–12 rep range.

02

Train to technical failure

Push the working set until another clean rep is no longer there.

03

Stay consistent

Stay consistent with your training and nutrition.
